title: Clarify Queue File Settings resolved override labels
summary: Add backend-authored resolved track action labels to the file override effective payload and use them in the Queue File Settings drawer.
reason: The drawer could show metadata-derived badges such as Kept by default while a stream would actually inherit normal subtitle policy and be dropped, which made the operator-facing file override state misleading.
behavior_before: Track rows rendered selection-preview badges such as Kept by default, exact-track blank options said Inherit, and clear controls/status used generic inherited wording that did not explain the effective saved policy value.
behavior_after: The effective file override payload includes resolved_track_actions, track rows render one backend-authored resolved action badge before metadata badges, source-default metadata is labeled Source default track, exact-track blank options say Use pipeline policy, and route/video/clear controls use saved-policy or value-aware source wording.
tests_added: DesktopApp/tests/test_file_override_tracks.py resolved_track_actions assertions for file override keep/drop, folder override keep/drop, unavailable probe metadata, subtitle language-policy drop, and subtitle conversion labels
DesktopApp/tests/test_application_facade_web_static.py Queue drawer copy and resolved-action rendering assertions
